editorial:
Imagine you are just settling into a new relationship, trying to balance your jobs and your love life, when suddenly a baby boy appears on your front porch right before Christmas. That is exactly what happens to Erin and Kelly. The whole vibe of the movie is cozy and sweet, making you feel like you are wrapped in a warm blanket. You get to watch these two women go from being totally overwhelmed to finding a rhythm as they handle diapers and midnight feedings. It is a heartwarming story about family and how love can come from the most unexpected places.

What really makes this one work is the chemistry between the leads; they feel like a real couple, which makes the stress of a surprise baby feel genuine. While the plot is a bit predictable, the cute baby scenes and the holiday scenery make up for it. If you are in the mood for something feel-good, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: At the end, Erin and Kelly discover the baby was left by a distant relative who couldn't care for him. Instead of giving him back to the state, they decide to legally adopt him as a family. The movie wraps up with a beautiful Christmas morning scene where they officially name the boy. They realize that the baby actually saved their relationship by teaching them how to work as a team and prioritize love over their careers.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves holiday rom-coms and stories about found families.
